title: Charred Chicken and Porcini Pilaf
description: A flavorful Thai-inspired dish featuring charred chicken and porcini pilaf, finished with a hint of Venezuelan spices.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
3. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
5. Add the porcini mushrooms and cook until fragrant, about 2-3 minutes.
6. Add the quick rice to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
7. Add the charred chili flakes, Venezuelan chimichurri, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
8. Stir to combine and cook for 1 minute.
9. Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
10. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
11. Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the pilaf.
12. Serve hot and garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
